findings.first_evidence: ios/TennisApp/Library.swift:73-74 -- if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath:input.path) { try FileManager.default.copyItem(at:input,to:target) } else if relative==manifest.media.path { throw PackageError.invalid("Source video is missing from package") }
findings.suggested_fix: Reject a package when any required artifact declared by manifest.artifacts is missing, import each required file, and initialize the store status from manifest.status instead of unconditionally setting .complete; only a manifest that is complete should produce a complete imported store.
findings.title: Incomplete imports are silently marked complete

findings.suggested_fix: Branch on manifest.status during import: retain imported results as complete only when the package is actually complete; for incomplete packages, either rebuild and checkpoint the full tracker/temporal RuntimeState from the imported frames or initialize a fresh zero-frame store and rerun inference from the contained source. Keep the stored status and ResumeIdentity consistent with the chosen path.
findings.title: Imported partial analyses are marked complete

findings.suggested_fix: In make_clip, load the video duration and convert start == end into a bounded window such as max(0, start - 2) through min(duration, end + 2), matching ios/TennisApp/AnalysisEngine.swift; keep explicit start/end for rallies.
findings.title: Point-event clip export always rejects

findings.first_evidence: ios/TennisApp/TennisApp.swift:35 -- Task { do { if package { _=try LocalLibrary.importPackage(url) } else { _=try await LocalLibrary.importVideo(url,players:players) }; try reload() } catch { self.error=error.localizedDescription }; busy=false }
findings.suggested_fix: Make package import asynchronous and run LocalLibrary.importPackage in a detached or dedicated actor task with explicit cancellation checks; await its result before calling the main-actor reload and error-state updates.
findings.title: Package import blocks the main actor

findings.first_evidence: ios/Sources/TennisCore/Contract.swift:121 -- if let p = position { guard p.count == 2, p.allSatisfy(\.isFinite) else { throw PackageError.invalid("Invalid court position") } }
findings.suggested_fix: In AnalysisEvent.validate, reject non-nil position unless kind == .bounce, then add a shared-fixture/import test for a hit carrying position and assert that both Swift and Python reject it.
findings.title: Swift accepts positions on non-bounce events

findings.suggested_fix: Change save to `(AnalysisEvent) throws -> Void`, call it with `try save(event)`, and have ReviewView's sheet closure perform store.saveEvent and refresh without the non-throwing perform wrapper so EventEditor keeps the sheet open and renders its local error on failure.
findings.title: Failed event saves still dismiss editor
